## What changed

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Security boundary

Does this change policy, approvals, IPC, identities, audit, credentials, sandboxing, network access or release provenance?

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant tests added/updated
- [ ] Relevant local tests pass
- [ ] No secrets, private keys or customer data included
- [ ] Security controls were not weakened to satisfy tests
- [ ] Documentation updated where behaviour changed

## Evidence

Include commands/results or a minimal reproducer for security-sensitive changes.
